title: SELECTCOLUMNS returns one row per source row, duplicates included, under the new name

source.quote: Both SELECTCOLUMNS and ADDCOLUMNS keep the duplicated rows included in the original table expression.
When the <Name> argument is specified, it defines a new name for the column reference, regardless of the data lineage result.
source.supports: the result column is named by the Name argument

derivation: Product has 4 rows with colours Red, Red, Blue, Green. All 4 are returned, in a column named [Color].
